card.name: Mexico and Southwest US context
card.fires_on: Words in texts tied to Mexico or the US Southwest, such as Mexican addresses and postal codes, Aztec names, or 'southern' before Utah or Arizona. It fires on the number or word just before a Mexico-related name.

modes.label: Mexican addresses
modes.description: Digits inside postal codes and addresses of Mexican institutions.

modes.label: Southwest region words
modes.description: The word southern before US Southwest states, or a direction word near Mexico.

modes.description: Partway through the name of an Aztec ruler.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward other place names and away from Mexico-related words, which is probably because Mexico is already implied.
card.plain: It lights up in text about Mexico or the US Southwest, where the next word is likely a nearby place name.
